control.description-key: Renders the full ancestor/descendant tree of a self-referential record hierarchy

property.name: parentLookup
property.description-key: The self-referential lookup field (e.g. Parent Contract) that defines where this record sits in the hierarchy. Place this control on that field.

property.name: showState
property.description-key: If true, displays an Active/Inactive pill for each record state.

property.name: showInactiveRecords
property.description-key: If true (default), inactive records are included in the tree and, when Show State is also true, show an Inactive pill. If false, inactive records - and everything below them in the tree - are left out entirely, and the state pill is hidden as well since every remaining record would just show Active.

property.name: maxParentLevels
property.description-key: Maximum number of ancestor levels to walk upward. 0 disables ancestor lookups entirely (no parent data is fetched). -1 walks all the way to the root (default). Any positive number caps how many levels are fetched.

property.name: maxChildLevels
property.description-key: Maximum number of descendant levels to walk downward. 0 disables descendant lookups entirely (no child data is fetched). -1 walks all the way to the leaves (default). Any positive number caps how many levels are fetched.

property.name: siblingDisplay
property.description-key: How to handle other records that share the same immediate parent as the current record. None hides them (default). Direct Only shows just those sister records. Sister Plus Children also shows the descendant tree under each sister record.

value.name: None
value.description-key: Do not show sister records.

value.name: DirectOnly
value.description-key: Show sister records, without their own children.

value.name: SistersAndChildren
value.description-key: Show sister records along with the descendant tree under each one.

property.name: sortByColumnName
property.description-key: Optional: logical name of a column used to order records that share the same level in the tree - each set of children under a shared parent, and sister records. When not set, records keep their default fetch order.

property.name: sortDirection
property.description-key: Direction to sort in when Sort By Column is set.

value.name: Ascending
value.description-key: Lowest value first.

value.name: Descending
value.description-key: Highest value first.

property.name: currentRecordHighlightColor
property.description-key: Hex color (e.g. #F3F2F1) used to highlight the current record row.

property.name: customAttribute1
property.description-key: Logical name of a column to display in each record row.

property.name: customAttribute2
property.description-key: Logical name of a column to display in each record row.

property.name: customAttribute3
property.description-key: Logical name of a column to display in each record row.

property.name: thumbnailColumnName
property.description-key: Optional: logical name of a column to render on the left of each record row. Point this at an Image column to show that picture, or at a text column containing an MDL2 icon name to show that icon instead - detected automatically from the column type.

property.name: thumbnailStyle
property.description-key: How the thumbnail image is rendered.

value.name: Circle
value.description-key: Renders the thumbnail as a circle.

value.name: Square
value.description-key: Renders the thumbnail as a square.

value.name: RoundedSquare
value.description-key: Renders the thumbnail as a square with rounded corners.

property.name: thumbnailRenderingOption
property.description-key: How the thumbnail image fills its frame.

value.name: Cover
value.description-key: Fills the frame, cropping the image as needed while keeping its aspect ratio (current/default behavior).

value.name: Stretch
value.description-key: Stretches the image to exactly fill the frame, ignoring its aspect ratio.

value.name: Contain
value.description-key: Fits the whole image inside the frame, keeping its aspect ratio, with empty space if needed.

value.name: Center
value.description-key: Shows the image at its natural size, centered, cropping any overflow.

value.name: Tile
value.description-key: Repeats the image to fill the frame.

value.name: FitWidth
value.description-key: Scales the image so its width fills the frame, keeping its aspect ratio.

value.name: FitHeight
value.description-key: Scales the image so its height fills the frame, keeping its aspect ratio.

property.name: quickViewFormName
property.description-key: Optional: the unique name of a Quick View Form on this table. When set, each row gets an expand chevron that displays the fields defined by that Quick View Form. A Main Form name also works and will show the fields from that form instead, as long as no Quick View Form shares the same name.

property.name: choiceColorDisplay
property.description-key: How Choice/optionset field colors are shown in the expandable Quick View panel. None keeps plain text (default). Circle shows a small color dot before the value. Pill shows the value inside a pill filled with the choice color. Font colors the value text itself.

value.name: None
value.description-key: Plain text, no color shown.

value.name: Circle
value.description-key: A small circle in the choice color before the value.

value.name: Pill
value.description-key: The value shown inside a pill filled with the choice color.

value.name: Font
value.description-key: The value text itself colored with the choice color.

property.name: indentation
property.description-key: How far each ancestor/descendant level is indented relative to its parent.

value.name: Low
value.description-key: Less indentation per level than the default.

value.name: Medium
value.description-key: The default indentation per level.

value.name: High
value.description-key: More indentation per level than the default.
